svg.text: 1 · Long setback: one curve leaves the road
Lane ends 14.9 m back, set by D and E. One curve
from exit to entry (dashed) cuts across C. The turn:
straight on, an arc of R = 4.89 m near K, straight on.
2 · The turn: the largest R that fits
An arc tangent to both lane lines, T = R·tan(θ/2)
before and after K. R: the largest with T ≤ a,
T ≤ b, c clear of every curb and corner: 4.89 m.
3 · A cross: every turn from S
Left round the far corner, R = 5.5 m; right
round the near one, R = 2.5 m. Only roadway
ends meet here: the corners alone keep it clear.
S into NW, past W: R = 11.2 m. Every corner on
the inside keeps it clear; W's mouth between
them is road, so a turn may cut across it.
5 · Side by side: one turn, moved
Lane 2 turns at R = 8.29 m, as wide as C allows;
lane 1 is it moved by v: 11.29 m round the same
Lane lines parallel: no corner to cut. A biarc,
as the Connector builds; here lane 2 merges
into B's only lane. A U-turn is one too.
Right-hand traffic. Pink: connection. Orange, dashed: one curve from exit to entry, refused. Gray, dashed: lane line on to K, clearance c around a corner. Blue: sizes.
